reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline or comment, which is the expected output; the cited paragraphs are unmodified in the rendered redline.

Cited text supports the preferred position from the licensee (AbbVie) side: Section 5.1.3(a) grants an exclusive licence to Exploit in the Field/Territory with no at-will revocation, Section 5.3 permits sublicensing through multiple tiers to Affiliates and other Persons (covering contractors acting on our behalf), Section 12.1.2 makes the grant fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable on expiry, and Section 13.4.1 allows assignment without consent to an Affiliate or M&A successor with the grant binding on Harpoon's successors.
Deterministic checks (affiliate coverage; no at-will revocation) both pass and are consistent with the rationale.
Rationale correctly notes the narrow, non-exclusive grant-back in Section 5.2 does not prejudice our position, so no negotiation issue is warranted.
